title: Reference Atlas: staged golden dataset release and config-coupling for eval rollouts
creator: Emma Chen
description: Goal: Build a "Reference Atlas" workflow for curated golden datasets that supports staged snapshot promotion, immutable snapshots with aliasing, fine-grained ACL propagation, and automated re-evals that are coupled to model/config changes. The Atlas will let us (1) create immutable snapshot artifacts of a prompt/eval bundle, (2) promote snapshots through environments (dev -> canary -> prod) with automated regression checks, and (3) keep per-team access controls and audit metadata so rollouts are auditable and reversible.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to snapshot + alias + simple promotion pipeline. Decided to call the artifact 'Reference Atlas snapshot' to avoid overloading 'golden'.
2026-02-28 - Design review with PM and Design (Ana Patel): Console needs a selector for 'target snapshot' per rollout and a diff view of snapshot changes before promotion.
2026-03-03 - Security review requested: will require KMS-wrapped storage for snapshots and RBAC checks on promotion endpoints. Security flagged retention/PII scanning for datasets.
2026-03-06 - Prototype PR created for snapshot manifest format and signer metadata. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4892
2026-03-09 - Blocker: snapshot index creation is slow for large bundles (10k+ items). Rafael investigating incremental indexing and pre-signed summary hashes.
2026-03-11 - Decision: use alias-based promotion (alias points to snapshot id) + immutable snapshots. Promotion will trigger an automated re-eval job tied to the change delta between alias targets.
2026-03-12 - Next: add console UX mock for staged promotion and a CI job that vetoes promotion on quality regression (>2% aggregate drop) unless manually overridden with audit note.
acceptance_criteria: API to create an immutable Reference Atlas snapshot from a prompt bundle, storing manifest, signer, and hash summary
Alias semantics implemented: aliases (dev/canary/prod) point to snapshot IDs and can be swapped atomically
ACLs and signer metadata are stored and enforced; attempting a promotion without proper ACL returns 403
Promotion pipeline triggers automated re-evals (canary job) that run configured eval suites and produce a regression report to the Console
Console shows snapshot selector, diff summary (counts of changed prompts), and a one-click promote action with required audit note when override is used
Promotion veto is enforced when automated regressions exceed configured thresholds; manual override requires an audit note and is logged
Snapshot storage and retrieval latency meets SLA: first-view of snapshot manifest < 1s for bundles <= 5k items
Security checklist: snapshots encrypted at rest with customer KMS (when configured), and dataset PII scan runs during snapshot creation
